cells.gaps: The sector policy letter is known only as initiative 1.1.8 of the national digitalisation strategy, published 2024-06-11: no row shows drafting begun, a text, a period, a delivery plan or a report, and nothing is dated in the twelve months to the as-at. The newest adopted sector policy, the 2010 Politique et stratégie nationales de développement des TIC (GIN-002, GIN-006), was open and is lapsed from 2016, when instruments.csv records the national 2016-2020 document replacing it; no text of it has been found. No governance row falls inside the 36 months: GIN-003 is dated 2010 and belongs to the 2010 policy.
cells.note: Lettre de politique sectorielle du numérique: announced as a costed initiative of the national digitalisation strategy, the only sector policy in preparation, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs an adopted sector policy with a public text and a period not ended; the 2010 policy was replaced in 2016 by the national strategy and is not in force.
